systems.vector_v3: shared hybrid retrieval only (no KG access)
systems.vector_v3_lex: vector_v3 + name-only query expansion from lexicon.json (KG used as a name dictionary; no edges, rules or provenance)
systems.graph_v3: identical shared retrieval + KG-linked rows inserted before fused results + merged entity cards
systems.full_context: all 86 original chunks, no retrieval (upper bound for this tiny corpus)
